page_title: RMA 0-4 BAR | Real Madrid v Barcelona 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' What was Gavi (Barcelona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
89' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
89' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.
89' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Barcelona win a corner.
88' The game is interrupted as Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is flagged offside.
87' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gavi (Barcelona) replacing Pedri.
87' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
86' Ferland Mendy will be replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
84' 0 - 4 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 0:4.
82' Inaki Pena (Barcelona) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
80' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
79' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:13.
77' 0 - 3 A sweet pass is collected by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) inside the penalty box and he unleashes a brilliant shot which goes into the roof of the net and behind the goalkeeper.
77' A substitution has been made. Eduardo Camavinga goes off and Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) comes on.
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
74' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
73' The attendance is 78192.
72' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Inaki Pena pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
69' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
68' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
66' A great pass puts Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
66' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
65' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Marc Casado will be replaced by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
65' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Inaki Pena is alert and denies him with a nice save.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Aurelien Tchouameni will be replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
61' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Inaki Pena.
60' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) takes it short.

60' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.

58' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
58' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
58' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.

56' 0 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Alejandro Balde is pounced on by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona). His close-range strike flashes past Andriy Lunin and into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
54' 0 - 1 Goal! Marc Casado plays a long ball to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:1.
53' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
52' The resulting corner, taken by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid), comes to nothing.

52' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
52' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Andriy Lunin is equal to it.
49' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
49' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
48' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is replaced by Frenkie de Jong.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Jose Sanchez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

44' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
44' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Marc Casado (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
43' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
40' Pedri (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

40' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
39' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
38' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) creates some space for himself and unleashes a strike from long range, but his effort sails just over the crossbar.
36' Jose Sanchez blows for a foul after Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
33' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
33' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
32' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Real Madrid players look gutted.
31' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Real Madrid players aren’t happy.
30' GOAL! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Inaki Pena, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
29' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
29' The corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) is hurriedly cleared.
29' Raphinha (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
28' Pedri (Barcelona) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Andriy Lunin was alert and made a comfortable save.
28' The percentage of ball possession is – 44:56.
26' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
24' Pedri (Barcelona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
23' Pedri (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' A brilliant individual effort! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
22' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Raphinha (Barcelona) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
21' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
19' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who has already been caught several times today.
19' An attempted cross from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is cleared.
16' Jose Sanchez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) and blew his whistle.
15' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.

13' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Andriy Lunin has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
13' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is caught offside!
12' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle.
11' Raphinha (Barcelona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
8' Great teamplay by Real Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) launches a cross from the corner, but Inaki Pena is alert to thwart the effort.
5' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. It will be a corner kick for Real Madrid.
5' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
4' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
3' Poor challenge! Pedri (Barcelona) is penalised for tripping and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle.
2' Flag up against Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Real Madrid will take the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
